judged_text: The recurring-booking cancellation branch still reads a single reference per booking (`updBooking.references.find(...)`) and only iterates `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, unlike the sibling non-recurring path this diff migrated to `filter` plus a DB credential fetch. Cancelling all remaining bookings of a recurring COLLECTIVE event deletes only the first host's calendar event per booking; the events this PR creates on the other hosts' calendars are never deleted and remain on their calendars indefinitely.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the recurring-event deletion path still uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, so it deletes at most one calendar reference per updated booking even though this PR now creates multiple calendar events for COLLECTIVE by pushing multiple destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` in `handleNewBooking.ts`) and `createAllCalendarEvents` iterates all `event.destinationCalendar`. Additionally, that recurring branch iterates only `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))` rather than deleting per-reference with credentialId/DB fallback (which the non-recurring path was migrated to). This mismatch means calendar events created for other hosts/destination calendars can be left undeleted.
